tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should furnish documentary evidence Work Done Certificates for having executed similar nature of work ie Supply of minimum 30 Nos of manpower for Collection and transportation of Segregated Municipal Solid waste for any Govt Organisation like city corporation within the last three financial years

The Tenderer should have achieved twice turnover quoted value in any one of the last Three Financial Years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 respectively. As documentary evidence the tenderer should furnish copies of Audited Balance Sheet duly certified by The Chartered Account.
